decisions.reason: Meeting the page limit does not change the mandated section order or permit section reordering.
The page-limit instruction does not remove or alter the requirement to incorporate the organization chart.
The source requests page-limit compliance but does not authorize omitting or changing supplied narrative content.
The source does not remove or modify the required budget sheet or proposal tables.
The page-limit instruction does not state that the table of contents should be removed or changed.
The source does not change the required photo selection or inclusion rules.
Page-limit compliance does not alter the Agua Arc identity, logo, or color requirements.
The source concerns the current RFQ document's length and does not change the deferred reusable-template requirement.
Spacing or layout may be used to satisfy the separate page-limit constraint, but the source does not change the existing layout and graphic-treatment requirement itself.
The page-limit instruction does not change the requirement that all hyperlinks remain functional.
Although spacing may contribute to document length, the source does not modify the required typeface or font-size consistency rules.
The page-limit instruction does not change Canva ownership, access, asset, editability, or reuse requirements.
